138040.notes: Q3 2026 results were announced on 11 Nov 2026. I could read them only in press reports (Shinailbo, Segye Ilbo, Dailian, Industry News, LCNews: all agree on 1.9621 trillion nine-month and 490.5 billion Q3 consolidated net profit), so primary: false. The company's own 3Q26 document was not found (KIND pages returned client errors; no 3Q26 file on meritzgroup.com surfaced in search). Prior-year values ARE primary: 3Q25 transcript gives Q3 2025 668.4 billion and 9M 2025 2.0268 trillion. Metric is consolidated net profit (includes about 2% non-controlling interest: 2025 total 2,350.1 vs owners 2,300.4 billion) because 9M 2026 EPS was not in any article. EPS is growing faster than net profit because of buybacks: 1H26 EPS 8,589 (+16.2%) while net profit rose 8.3%; so per-share 9M change is probably positive, but I have no figure. Primary EPS facts if wanted: 1H 2026 EPS +16.2% (8,589), Q1 2026 +17.1% (3,926), from the 2Q26 and 1Q26 call transcripts. Cause of the Q3 drop per the press: lower investment income from stock valuation losses at Meritz Fire (no amount given; Fire Q3 standalone profit 328.5 billion, -29.2%). This could arguably qualify for `exclude` (securities valuation), but no amount is disclosed, so I did not exclude it. No profit guidance from the company. No permanent cause found: insurance profit rose 7.6% in nine months. No cash dividend: the company directs all shareholder return to buyback and cancellation (press report of 11 Feb 2026; 2025 dividend cell blank in the company's status disclosure; 2024 DPS was 1,350 won), so dividend is null.
